rationale: Third scenario for the same obligation, now on the real message path: a PreAccept carrying two commands whose first value is 70000 bytes marshals to 70063 bytes, and the implementation's own decoder panics with makeslice len out of range, leaving 15700 bytes in the buffer. The harness wraps only the decode in recover so the panic is reported rather than killing the test; the reader path in production has no recover around its unmarshal, so the panic would end the receiver's process. The trusted runner and a fresh correspondence review decide the formal outcome.
